description: Fleet Checklist items: single source for scrPreTrip, column scripts and the wording document. commentOn = the answer that requires a comment (and photos for photo 'multi').

items.instruction: Filled in from the truck you scanned or typed on the home screen; go back to the home screen to change it.
items.notes: Locked: DisplayMode View, value comes from varTruck.

items.instruction: Filled in from your sign-in; check it is your name.
Enter the site you are leaving from. The form will not submit without it.
items.notes: Now required (was optional).

items.proposedName: Do you have a valid driver's licence with you?
items.instruction: Tick Yes only if your licence is on you today and has not expired.
Read the km on the dashboard, type the number exactly and take a photo of it.
items.notes: Moved from the footer to second item.

items.instruction: Copy the km from the service sticker; leave blank if there is no sticker.
Open, close and lock both doors; each must shut and lock properly.
items.notes: Windows now checked by the four glass items.

items.proposedName: Front / rear windscreens free of cracks
items.instruction: Replaced by the four glass items.
items.notes: Hidden: replaced by CabGlassFront/Rear/Driver/Passenger. Column kept.

items.proposedName: Front windscreen free of cracks and chips?
items.instruction: Look across the whole windscreen from inside and outside; any crack or chip is a No.

items.proposedName: Rear cabin window free of cracks?
items.instruction: Look at the small window behind the seats; any crack is a No.

items.proposedName: Driver's door window free of cracks and working?
items.instruction: Wind the window fully down and up; it must move freely and have no cracks.

items.proposedName: Passenger's door window free of cracks and working?
items.instruction: Wind the window fully down and up; it must move freely and have no cracks.

items.currentName: Rear Vision Mirrors / Immediate Vicinity Check Mirrors
items.proposedName: Mirrors clean, uncracked and set for you?
items.instruction: Check every mirror is clean, not cracked or loose, and you can see down both sides of the truck.
Pull each belt out, click it in and release it; it must lock, unlock and roll back freely.

items.proposedName: Dashboard gauges and warning lights working?
items.instruction: Start the engine; all gauges move and no warning light stays on.
No rubbish, food or loose items in the cabin; take a photo of the cabin.
items.notes: Moved from Accessory Checks.

items.instruction: Both floor mats are in place; take a photo.
items.notes: Moved from Accessory Checks.

items.instruction: Tilt the cabin, check underneath for leaks, loose parts or damage, then lower and lock it.
items.notes: Weekly, reviewer only: shown as done if a signed-off checklist for the same truck this week (Mon–Sun) has Yes.

items.instruction: Take a clear photo of the weight plate (usually on the door pillar) so the numbers can be read.
items.notes: Photo only; may need no SharePoint column.

items.proposedName: Battery water at the top mark?
items.instruction: Look at the battery cells; water must reach the top mark.

items.currentName: Battery Terminals (No Loose Terminals / Acid Build Up)
items.instruction: Terminals must not move by hand and have no white or green build-up.
Turn the isolator off and on; power cuts and returns.

items.currentName: Head / Fog Light (Left and Right) Functional
items.instruction: Switch on low beam, high beam and fog lights; left and right must all light.
Switch on left then right indicators and hazards; walk around and check front and rear flash.
Press the brake (or ask someone to) and check both rear brake lights come on.

items.proposedName: Reverse alarm and reverse lights working?
items.instruction: Select reverse; the alarm beeps and both reverse lights come on.
Switch on the cabin light; it must light.
Switch on the rear spotlight; it must light.
Press the horn; it must sound clearly.

items.currentName: Truck / Bulk Bin Electrical Cables (Damage Free)
items.proposedName: Truck and bin electrical cables undamaged?
items.instruction: Look along visible cables; no cuts, bare wire or loose plugs.
Replaced by a comment on each item and Other comments.

items.currentName: Tyre Condition (Any Retreads on Steer Wheels)
items.instruction: Walk around every tyre: no cuts, bulges or bald spots, and no retreads on the front (steering) wheels.
items.notes: Duplicates a main checklist item (AccTyreCondition); keeping both until confirmed with Krish.

items.proposedName: All wheel nuts and studs in place?
items.instruction: Look at every wheel; no nut or stud missing or loose.
The spare is on the truck, inflated and with no cuts or bald spots.
items.notes: Duplicates a main checklist item (AccSpareTyre); keeping both until confirmed with Krish.

items.currentName: Jack / Wheel Brace / Accessories (All Present and Functional)
items.proposedName: Jack and wheel brace in the truck and working?
items.instruction: The jack and wheel brace are on the truck and not broken.
items.notes: Overlaps AccEngJack / AccEngWheelBrace.

items.instruction: Replaced by a comment on each item and Other comments.
Look on the ground under the engine and gearbox; no fresh drips or puddles.

items.proposedName: Engine and hydraulic oil at the top level?
items.instruction: Check the dipstick and hydraulic tank; oil must be at the top mark.
With the engine cold, the coolant tank must be at the top mark.

items.currentName: Air Hoses Condition (Any Signs of Leaks)
items.proposedName: Air hoses free of leaks and damage?
items.instruction: Listen for hissing and look along the hoses; no cracks, rubbing or leaks.
items.notes: Moved from Brakes and Tyres.

items.currentName: Fan Belts (Alternator, Cooling Fan, A/C etc.)
items.proposedName: Fan belts in good condition and tight?
items.instruction: Belts are not cracked or frayed and do not move more than a finger's width when pressed.
items.notes: Engine item placed here because it is checked with the fluids – confirm.

items.instruction: Replaced by a comment on each item and Other comments.

items.currentName: Springs / U-Bolts / Bin Mounting Nuts and Bolts
items.proposedName: Springs, U-bolts and bin bolts secure?
items.instruction: Look at the springs and bin mountings; nothing broken, missing or loose.

items.currentName: Front and Rear Bumpers – Impact Absorption
items.proposedName: Front and rear bumpers secure and undamaged?
items.instruction: Bumpers are firmly fixed with no loose or broken parts.

items.currentName: PTO (Pump, Seals, Cable, Shaft, Augers, Universal Joint)
items.instruction: Check the pump, seals, cable, shaft, augers and universal joint; nothing leaking, loose or damaged.
items.notes: Moved from Engine and Transmission.

items.instruction: Replaced by a comment on each item and Other comments.

items.proposedName: Foot brake and park brake working?
items.instruction: The truck holds still on the park brake and the foot brake feels firm.
items.notes: Moved from Brakes and Tyres.

items.proposedName: Cones and reflector triangle in the truck?
items.instruction: The cones and the reflector triangle are on the truck.
items.notes: Duplicates a main checklist item (AccTrafficCones); keeping both until confirmed with Krish.

items.instruction: You have your hi-vis vest, safety boots and gloves.

items.proposedName: Fire extinguisher in place and in date?
items.instruction: The extinguisher is mounted, the gauge is in the green and the tag is in date.
items.notes: Duplicates a main checklist item (AccFireExtinguisher); keeping both until confirmed with Krish.

items.proposedName: First aid box in the truck and stocked?
items.instruction: Open the box; it is on the truck and not empty.
items.notes: Duplicates a main checklist item (AccFirstAidKit); keeping both until confirmed with Krish.

items.instruction: Switch on the torch; it must light.

items.currentName: Rain Coat and Helmet (Present / Good Condition)
items.proposedName: Raincoat and helmet in the truck?
items.instruction: Both are on the truck and not torn or broken.
Replaced by a comment on each item and Other comments.

items.currentName: Greasing Has Been Carried Out to Moving / Rotating Parts
items.instruction: Check the grease points under the truck have fresh grease; grease any that are dry.
items.notes: Weekly, reviewer only: shown as done if a signed-off checklist for the same truck this week (Mon–Sun) has Yes.

items.instruction: The wheel chocks (angle blocks) are on the truck.

items.currentName: Freezer and Dry Box Locked (Padlock / Seal #)
items.instruction: Each box has its padlock or seal fitted.
items.notes: Kept for all trucks (ambient trucks have a dry box); may become Frozen-only for the freezer part – confirm with Krish.

items.proposedName: Money bag and lock in the truck?
items.instruction: The money bag and its lock are on the truck.

items.currentName: Money Box Available in the Truck
items.instruction: Removed.
items.notes: Removed from the screen; column kept, unused.

items.instruction: Replaced by a comment on each item and Other comments.
Read the expiry date on the COF label, pick it in the date box and take a photo of the label.
items.notes: Scan button to be added once a label sample shows a QR code/barcode.

items.instruction: Read the due date on the blower service label, pick it in the date box and take a photo of the label.
items.notes: Frozen-only is a placeholder – confirm with Krish. Label sample needed for scanning.

items.instruction: Read the due date on the service sticker, pick it in the date box and take a photo of the sticker.
The spare tyre is on the truck; take a photo of it.
items.notes: Duplicates a main checklist item (field_34); keeping both until confirmed with Krish.

items.instruction: Take one photo of each tyre; tick Yes if every tyre has good tread and no damage.
items.notes: Number of photos from NoOfTyres in the Trucks list, 6 if not found. Duplicates a main checklist item (field_32); keeping both until confirmed with Krish.

items.instruction: The extinguisher is mounted and its tag is in date; take a photo.
items.notes: Duplicates a main checklist item (field_39); keeping both until confirmed with Krish.

items.proposedName: First aid kit in the truck?
items.instruction: The first aid kit is on the truck; take a photo.
photoSlots: First aid kit in the truck?
items.notes: Duplicates a main checklist item (field_40); keeping both until confirmed with Krish.

items.instruction: The traffic cones are on the truck; take a photo.
items.notes: Duplicates a main checklist item (field_37); keeping both until confirmed with Krish.

items.instruction: The truck's fuel card is in the cabin; take a photo.

items.proposedName: Fridge plug-in lead in the truck?
items.instruction: The plug-in lead for the fridge unit is on the truck; take a photo.
photoSlots: Fridge plug-in lead in the truck?
items.notes: Frozen-only is a placeholder – confirm with Krish.

items.instruction: The jack with this truck's engraving is on the truck; take a photo.
items.notes: Overlaps field_35.

items.proposedName: Engraved wheel brace in the truck?
items.instruction: The wheel brace with this truck's engraving is on the truck; take a photo.
photoSlots: Engraved wheel brace in the truck?
items.notes: Overlaps field_35.

items.instruction: The pipe with this truck's engraving is on the truck; take a photo.

items.proposedName: Engraved spare-tyre winder in the truck?
items.instruction: The spare-tyre winder with this truck's engraving is on the truck; take a photo.
photoSlots: Engraved spare-tyre winder in the truck?

items.instruction: The trolley with this truck's engraving is on the truck; take a photo.
The floor of the load area is clean with no holes or broken boards; take a photo.
Replaced by a comment on each item and Other comments.
Walk around the truck. If you find new damage, tick Yes, describe it and take a photo of each spot.
items.notes: Inverted: Yes is the problem answer, so the comment and photos are required on Yes.

items.proposedName: Truck photos: front, rear, left and right
items.instruction: Stand back and take one photo of each side so the whole truck is in the picture.
items.notes: Photo only; may need no SharePoint column.

items.instruction: Anything else the office should know (optional).
